question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 monitoring requirements marked with footnote *1, does 'When discharging.' establish that the stated monitoring frequencies apply only during periods when the permittee is actually discharging at Outfall 001, so that periods without discharge are periods in which those monitoring requirements were not applicable?
required_context: Outfall 001 is characterized as Intermittent Flow in Section A.1
Monitoring frequencies for pH, Flow, Total Suspended Solids, Total Residual Chlorine, Cyanide, and Total Dissolved Solids are marked (*1) in the discharge limitations table
Footnote *1 on page 4 defines (*1) as 'When discharging.'
notes: Footnote *1 conditions multiple Outfall 001 monitoring frequencies on discharge occurrence. Resolving whether monitoring obligations are discharge-active versus continuous directly affects which monitoring requirements were applicable (Purpose B) and whether no-discharge periods constitute conditional monitoring not required versus missing required evidence (Purpose C).
